description: Screenshot of Q post No.7943219 on 8kun, dated 01/28/20, tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6, with a block of reply links at top. The drop claims Epstein was 'highlighted' deliberately, that those once protected no longer are, and closes 'Hunters become PREY.'

description: Screen capture of a Fox News on-air graphic titled 'Inspector General Report', quoting handwritten-note language attributed to page 294 of the DOJ Inspector General report regarding the Anthony Weiner laptop investigation. A red oval annotation (added to the screenshot, not part of the broadcast) circles the lines 'Hillary Clinton & Foundation / Crime Against Children'. The graphic presents the quoted notes as claims from the report; a Kashmir-related news ticker runs along the bottom and a small circular watermark sits at lower right.
text: INSPECTOR GENERAL REPORT. (3) Wiener [sic] - texting 15 yo - Sexually Explicit. Initial analysis of laptop - thousands emails. Hillary Clinton & Foundation. Crime Against Children. PAGE 294. FOX NEWS. 10:08 ET. MIR," AND SUPPORTED PEACEFUL RESOLUTION OF KASHMIR CONFLICT... DISPUTE DATES TO 1947 PART...
orgs: Department of Justice Office of Inspector General
flags: The circled 'Crime Against Children' line is a quoted case-note phrase presented as a claim; the graphic implies wrongdoing not established as fact
Red oval is an added annotation emphasizing the claim
Small circular watermark at lower right not fully legible

description: The widely published photograph showing Prince Andrew with his arm around the waist of a teenage Virginia Roberts (later Virginia Giuffre), with Ghislaine Maxwell standing behind them in a doorway. Reportedly taken in March 2001 at Maxwell's London townhouse and later produced by Giuffre in her allegations against Andrew; the image carries a '© Virginia Roberts' watermark. Andrew has publicly questioned the photo's authenticity; Giuffre maintained it is genuine.
flags: Virginia Roberts was 17 when the photo was reportedly taken; she later publicly identified herself in it as an adult
Prince Andrew has disputed the photograph's authenticity; date and location are as reported, not shown in the image

description: Photograph of Bill Clinton standing with Ghislaine Maxwell in the doorway of a private jet, at the top of the boarding stairs; Clinton rests his arm on Maxwell's shoulder. Widely published in 2020 and reported to have been taken aboard Jeffrey Epstein's Boeing 727 around 2002, during trips Clinton took on the plane. The back of an unidentified person's head is in the near foreground.
flags: Aircraft identification as Epstein's jet and the circa-2002 date come from press reporting, not from anything visible in the image
Foreground person unidentified and left anonymous

description: Annotated version of the widely published 2006 photograph from Princess Beatrice's 18th-birthday costume party at Windsor Castle, showing Harvey Weinstein in white tie, Jeffrey Epstein in a white naval-officer costume with a SEAL trident insignia and medals, and Ghislaine Maxwell in a Venetian mask with a red feathered headdress. Large red X marks have been drawn over each of the three faces, a common annotation implying the subjects have been 'taken down' or targeted.
flags: Red X marks are added annotations editorializing on the photo
Maxwell's face is masked in the photo; her identification follows widespread press reporting of this image
Epstein's uniform and medals were a costume, not an earned uniform
